specs.title: T22: invalid edit → visible reason → server invalid → active plan unchanged → fix
keyboard editing: arrows move the selected part, R rotates, table reflects coordinates
tempered remnant is drawn as one whole part without cut lines
solve job shows real stages, last valid plan and comparison; plan not applied automatically
NEW parts show distinct reasons; UNKNOWN is not called impossible
T45: seven metrics with denominators and source-row drill-down
filters validate the day range and show unknown manager group label
route 1: free request, clarification, quote, candidate R006, confirm and reserve
T23: concurrent remnant change before reservation returns a visible conflict
form input survives a refresh and an API error
immutable source snapshot cannot be confirmed; working copy is offered
route 2: 450→451 marks the old total stale and creates revision 2 with a diff
T28: quantity 2 of the original part is 3 976,00
T27: unmapped catalog product is not "no stock" and not NEW; no invented total
ambiguous unit input asks for clarification instead of rounding
route 3: 25 rows, grouped clients, reminder draft → confirm without outbound sending
T43: workplace reminder keeps the quote customer separate from the recipient
T44: a reminder for a specific remnant becomes stale when the remnant is taken; confirmation is blocked
validated_model policy that was not promoted is shown as a conflict, not as results
route 4: contest run produces five files of one run; no official closed scores
T53: assistant failure gives a partial package, never a fake complete one
a non-contest snapshot is flagged before running
T36: AI offline keeps the local calculation and labels the dialog as limited
network loss shows "no connection" with retry; nothing is fabricated
429 shows the rate limit with a retry hint and keeps the input
undelivered backend operation is shown as "not connected", not as data
T48: cards → plan change → stale, export blocked
T49: card coefficient outside 0.30–0.70 is rejected before sending
